sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish
relevance_score_definition: 0 < x <= 1, with a higher score indicating higher relevance.

feed.title: Prediction: Broadcom Will Be a $3 Trillion Company by the End of 2030
feed.summary: The article predicts that Broadcom will become a $3 trillion company by the end of 2030, representing about 76% upside from its current market value of $1.7 trillion. This prediction is largely based on Broadcom's aggressive revenue targets, particularly in AI semiconductors, which management expects to reach $230 billion in fiscal year 2028. The author argues that achieving this valuation does not require multiple expansion, but rather the company delivering on its secured supply and revenue forecasts, though profitability margins are noted as a key risk.

feed.title: Bull of the Day: NVIDIA Corp. (NVDA)
feed.summary: NVIDIA Corp. (NVDA) has regained its Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) status, driven by strong fiscal second-quarter 2027 results where it beat earnings estimates and saw revenue soar 106%. Analysts remain bullish, with estimates for fiscal 2027 and 2028 showing significant earnings and sales growth. Despite a "break" in its stock performance in 2026, NVDA is still up 20.4% year-to-date and is considered attractively priced with a forward P/E of 24.

feed.title: SmartHarvest Portfolios LLC Increases Holdings in NVIDIA Corporation $NVDA

feed.title: Kraft Heinz Trades at a Fraction of PepsiCo's Valuation. Is the Discount Deserved?
feed.summary: This article analyzes whether Kraft Heinz's significantly lower valuation compared to PepsiCo and the S&P 500 is justified. It highlights Kraft Heinz's ongoing struggles with declining sales despite management's turnaround efforts, suggesting it might be a value trap. Conversely, PepsiCo's recent turnaround initiatives and positive sales growth make it a more appealing prospect for value investors.

feed.title: Alibaba Just Supercharged its AI Ambitions: New Zhenwu V900 AI Chip Promises 3X Performance, Targets 20GW
feed.summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. has unveiled its new Zhenwu V900 AI chip, promising three times the performance of its predecessor, and plans to expand Alibaba Cloud's global data center capacity to over 20 gigawatts by 2032. The new chip is set for mass production and commercial release in Q1 2027, with existing Zhenwu chips already serving over 650 customers. This move aligns with a broader trend among tech giants like Nvidia and Meta Platforms to significantly boost AI infrastructure.

feed.title: Why Rackspace Technology (RXT) Is Up 15.8% After Joining NVIDIA’s Cloud Partner Program
feed.summary: Rackspace Technology (RXT) experienced a 15.8% stock increase after joining NVIDIA’s Cloud Partner Program, which enhances its ability to offer NVIDIA-accelerated computing and governed AI cloud services. This partnership, especially the introduction of Rackspace's Institutional Sovereign Pod combining NVIDIA Blackwell and Palantir Foundry, is crucial for its pivot towards regulated enterprise AI. While this move could drive growth in complex AI workloads, investors are cautioned about potential sustained pressure on margins and free cash flow if AI offerings don't scale rapidly enough to offset challenges in legacy cloud services.

feed.title: Goldman Leads Sale of $1.1 Billion Junk Bond for CoreWeave-Leased Data Center
feed.summary: A Goldman Sachs-led group is marketing $1.1 billion in high-yield debt to finance a new data center near Richmond, Virginia. The Digital Drive campus will provide 76 megawatts of IT capacity, fully contracted by CoreWeave for 15 years in a $2.94 billion deal. The bonds are expected to yield in the low to mid 9 percent range, with pricing anticipated for Wednesday.

feed.title: Adobe CEO Shantanu Narayen Sells $31.3 Million Stock
feed.summary: Adobe CEO Shantanu Narayen sold approximately 125,000 shares of Adobe Inc. stock for a total of $31.3 million on September 16-17, 2026, representing 34% of his total position. The sale was executed through The Narayen Family Trust and cited as being for personal tax and estate planning purposes. Despite the significant sale and a 30% decline in the stock's value over the past year, the company's growth in fiscal 2026 and current valuation suggest the sale was not driven by concerns about Adobe's business prospects.

feed.title: Coherent launches optical platform for AI datacenters
feed.summary: Coherent Corp. (NYSE:COHR) has launched PhotonLink, an integrated optical platform designed for AI datacenters. This new platform combines various photonics technologies to support co-packaged optics, near-packaged optics, and chip-to-chip connectivity. Coherent expects revenue from PhotonLink to start ramping up in the fourth quarter of calendar year 2026.

feed.title: AMD joins the $1 trillion club, leaving Intel behind
feed.summary: AMD has achieved a $1 trillion market capitalization for the first time, driven by investor enthusiasm for its growing AI and data-center business. This milestone places AMD ahead of longtime rival Intel, whose market value is around $644 billion, though it remains significantly smaller than Nvidia. The company's recent stock rally, with shares up over 180% this year, reflects strong demand for AI hardware and AMD's robust growth in its Data Center segment.

feed.title: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Is Up 12.1% After Record AI Backlog Sparks Major Capacity Expansion
feed.summary: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) has seen its stock rise by 12.1% following a record AI-focused order backlog, including over US$60 billion in new fourth-quarter orders. The company is expanding its global manufacturing capacity to produce more than 6,000 racks per month to meet growing data center demand, with AI solutions now contributing the majority of its quarterly revenue. This growth sharpens the company's investment narrative but also highlights risks related to customer concentration and potential order lumpiness.

feed.title: Why Turning Point Brands Stock Dived by 10% Today
feed.summary: Turning Point Brands' stock dropped 10% following two key announcements: an unexpected change in leadership with CEO Graham Purdy stepping down due to personal reasons, and a reduction in the high end of its full-year EBITDA forecast from $90 million to $70 million. These developments, coupled with existing challenges in the tobacco industry, have increased investor concern, despite the company maintaining its sales estimates for oral tobacco products. The article suggests that while not necessarily a cause for panic, the stock is not considered a buy given the industry's difficulties.

feed.title: Jefferies Financial stock may move 5.8% on Sept. 28 earnings
feed.summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. stock is predicted to move 5.8% based on options data when the company reports earnings on September 28. Historically, the actual stock price movement has exceeded this implied volatility in three out of the last eight earnings announcements. For instance, in June, options suggested a 6.4% move, but the stock fell 15.1% after the earnings release.

feed.title: Broadcom’s AI Opportunity Is Bigger Than Its Stock Price Suggests
feed.summary: Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) recently reported its ninth consecutive earnings beat, with AI revenue skyrocketing 221% year-over-year, yet its stock has remained relatively flat in 2026. Despite this performance, the company's shares are trading at a discount compared to competitors like NVIDIA, suggesting a significant undervalued AI opportunity. Analysts project a strong upside for Broadcom, driven by robust partnerships with major hyperscalers like Meta and OpenAI, and an insatiable demand for XPUs and networking solutions in the AI sector.

feed.title: Jensen Huang Isn't 'Afraid' of Paying $8 Billion in California's Billionaire Tax: Nvidia CEO Says This Is What Scares Him Instead

Huang, with an estimated $184 billion fortune, joked that he's not afraid of paying taxes, but rather of being poor. He described himself as "the ultimate American dream," attributing his success to opportunities in the U.S. and his early career as a dishwasher.

feed.title: Nvidia boss rejects AI extinction fears as 'doomsday narratives'
feed.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has dismissed warnings about AI leading to humanity's extinction as "doomsday narratives," calling such fears irresponsible and not grounded in science. He suggested that some AI firms pushing for a slowdown in development might be seeking liability protections rather than genuine regulatory changes. Huang's stance aligns with other tech workers who are skeptical of mass extinction scenarios from AI.

feed.title: Nvidia’s Vera CPU Changes the Fight With Intel and AMD
feed.summary: Nvidia's new Vera server CPU is poised to disrupt the CPU market currently dominated by Intel and AMD. Instead of directly competing chip-for-chip, Nvidia aims to integrate Vera into complete AI computing systems, leveraging its existing relationships with customers for GPUs, networking, and software. This strategy focuses on providing an entire AI infrastructure solution, allowing Nvidia to capture a larger share of the rapidly growing AI data center market.

feed.title: The AI Slowdown Trade Has Some Winners: CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Rally While Chips Fall
feed.summary: Amid calls for a slowdown in AI development, a "risk-off" market move saw money shift from chip stocks to cybersecurity companies like Palo Alto Networks (PANW) and CrowdStrike Holdings (CRWD), which rallied significantly. Industry leaders, including OpenAI's Sam Altman and Elon Musk, supported Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's essay advocating for a slower pace of AI advancement due to potential threats. Cybersecurity firms capitalized on this narrative, arguing that increased AI capabilities necessitate more robust security investments, although investors are cautioned to await actual demand data from upcoming earnings reports rather than relying solely on this sentiment-driven rally.

feed.title: Coherent Showcases Optical Innovations to Scale AI Infrastructure at ECOC 2026
feed.summary: Coherent Corp. (NYSE: COHR) is showcasing new optical technologies and live demonstrations at ECOC 2026 in Málaga, Spain, aimed at scaling AI infrastructure. The innovations address challenges in power, integration, and thermal management, with a focus on datacenter connectivity, co-packaged and near-packaged optics, next-generation transceivers, and advanced materials. Key demonstrations include a new PhotonLink integrated optics platform, 3.2T 2xDR4 transceivers, 6.4T NPO optical engines, and various optical components designed for high-density AI applications.

feed.title: Apple's Big Week: iPhone 18 Pro, Nvidia AI Servers, Musk Drops Lawsuit - Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL), SAMSUNG ELE

Apple is also reportedly exploring a major entry into the AI server market, potentially integrating its M8 Ultra chips with Nvidia's NVLink Fusion technology. Meanwhile, Samsung has recaptured the lead in the global smartphone market, and Elon Musk's xAI has dropped Apple from its antitrust lawsuit.

feed.title: Uranium Energy vs. Cameco: If I Could Only Own 1 Uranium Stock for the Next Decade, I'd Buy This 1
feed.summary: As global energy demand rises and the perspective on nuclear energy shifts, the uranium mining sector is experiencing significant tailwinds. This article compares two major uranium players, Uranium Energy (UEC) and Cameco (CCJ), highlighting their different risk profiles and business models. While Uranium Energy offers higher upside potential for aggressive investors due to its unhedged uranium sales and U.S. focus, Cameco is presented as a more stable investment for the next decade, owing to its integrated business model, long-term contracts, and broader exposure across the nuclear value chain.

feed.title: United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby Has a Simple PowerPoint Rule — And This Strict Limit Shows How Seriously He Takes It
feed.summary: United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby enforces a strict "no reading slides" rule for meetings, requiring PowerPoint decks to be sent in advance to encourage conversation. He believes his job as CEO is to "think hard," not "work hard," dedicating significant time to reading and focusing on future strategy. This approach is similar to other prominent CEOs like Jeff Bezos and Jensen Huang, who have also redefined traditional meeting norms to foster more substantive discussions.

feed.title: Equinix Sees AI Driving Data Center Demand, Interconnection Growth
feed.summary: Equinix executives indicate that artificial intelligence is significantly accelerating demand for high-density data center capacity and interconnection services, requiring more complex, low-latency infrastructure. The company's interconnection business grew 9% this year, supported by new offerings like Fabric One and Inference Exchange, which address the complex networking needs of AI workloads. Equinix anticipates 9%-12% annual adjusted funds from operations per-share growth through 2029, driven by robust demand and development projects generating mid-20% cash yields.

feed.title: KeyCorp Reaffirms 2026 Outlook as Loan Growth, Margins and Fees Gain Momentum
feed.summary: KeyCorp has reaffirmed its 2026 outlook, citing strong client activity, anticipated commercial loan growth at the higher end of its 4-5% target, improved credit quality, and deposit growth exceeding 2% in the latter half of the year. The bank raised its fee-income growth outlook to 4-5% following the Clearwater acquisition and is increasingly confident in achieving a core return on tangible common equity of over 15% by 2027. Despite a changing economic backdrop with expected rate increases, KeyCorp sees continued healthy activity in both lending and fee-based businesses.

feed.title: How Investors Are Reacting To Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical (RARE) First-In-Disease Gene Therapy Approval For FAYUVI
feed.summary: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical received full FDA approval for FAYUVI (UX111), a first-in-disease gene therapy for pediatric Sanfilippo syndrome Type A, alongside a Priority Review Voucher. This approval, coupled with another recent gene therapy approval for GENGLYCOS, expands Ultragenyx's commercial gene therapy portfolio. While these approvals improve the near-term outlook, investors should consider the company's high cash burn and potential for dilution, as the speed of adoption and reimbursement will be crucial for reaching profitability goals.

feed.title: Joby Aviation (JOBY) Completes First Autonomous Cross Country Flight In The United States
feed.summary: Joby Aviation (JOBY) has completed the first fully autonomous cross-country flight in the U.S., with its electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft flying without a pilot, monitored remotely. This milestone supports Joby's strategy for autonomous logistics, focusing on commercial cargo, medical supply, disaster relief, and defense logistics. The company aims to monetize its technology stack beyond passenger air taxis, but faces challenges in managing a broad business model compared to more focused rivals.

feed.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Rejects Calls to Slow Down AI Development: ‘We Are Going to Go as Fast We Can, But…’
feed.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has rejected calls to slow down AI development, asserting that the industry should advance as quickly as possible while ensuring product safety. He emphasized the importance of rapid AI progress for U.S. economic growth, even as other tech leaders like Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg have voiced concerns about the pace and called for increased safety measures and independent evaluations. Huang's comments come as Nvidia's stock continues to perform strongly amid surging AI demand.
